Hardwired is dedicated to making engineering easy to understand.

We create educational videos about electronics, electrical engineering, embedded systems, computer hardware, communication protocols, and the technology behind everyday devices.

Whether you’re an engineer, a student, or simply curious about how things work, you’ll find clear explanations, animations, and real hardware demonstrations.

Subscribe and explore the engineering behind modern technology.

Stay curious. Stay Hardwired.
